---
title: "Contribute"
---

Methods in Microbiomics is written by members of the Sunagawa group and the NCCR Microbiomes. Corrections and new lessons are welcome.

- **Found a mistake or a broken link?** Use *Report an issue* in the right margin of any page, or [open an issue](https://github.com/MicrobiologyETHZ/Methods_in_Microbiomics/issues/new).
- **Want to fix it yourself?** Use *Edit this page*, or open a pull request against the `next` branch.

## How a lesson is built

| Folder | Content |
|---|---|
| `site/lessons/<lesson>/` | The lesson pages (Quarto `.qmd`), with live R cells for the browser |
| `workshop/<lesson>/` | What learners get in the Codespace: input data, the `check` command and reference solutions |
| `data-prep/<lesson>/` | Scripts that rebuild all lesson data from the raw downloads |
| `.devcontainer/` | The Codespace definition and its software environment |
| `tests/` | Runs every page's commands and R cells, as a learner would |

Every number shown in a lesson comes from the data-prep scripts, and the tests check that the pages' own commands reproduce it. If you change a command on a page, run the tests:

```bash
python tests/page_commands.py workshop/gene-catalogs site/lessons/gene-catalogs/0[1-3]*.qmd
python tests/webr_cells.py site/lessons/gene-catalogs/0[1-4]*.qmd
```

To preview the site locally, install [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and run `quarto preview` in `site/`.
